Both verification steps pass.

## Summary

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVPrinterAgentTest.java` — 47 tests, all green. No other files touched.

**Conventions matched:** JUnit 4.11, `org.junit.Test`, static `org.junit.Assert.*` imports, `@Test(expected = ...)` for error cases, `StringWriter` + `assertEquals` on `sw.toString()` — same as the existing `CSVPrinterTest`. Only the public API of `CSVPrinter` is exercised (constructor, `print`, `println`, `printComment`, `printRecord`, `printRecords`, `close`, `flush`, `getOut`).

**Coverage highlights (assertions on output/state, not just "no throw"):**

- **Constructor errors:** null appendable → `IllegalArgumentException`, null format → `IllegalArgumentException`, inconsistent format (`Quote.NONE` without escape) → `IllegalStateException`.
- **`getOut()`** returns the same appendable instance (`assertSame`).
- **`print`:** delimiter inserted only between values (no trailing separator); non-String uses `toString()`; `null` first-on-line → `""`, `null` mid-line → empty, `null` with `withNullString` → the configured token; empty string first-on-line quoted; MINIMAL quoting of delimiter / embedded quote (doubled) / newline / leading space / trailing space / value starting with `#`; quoting-disabled writes raw; escaping mode escapes delimiter and `\n`; `Quote.ALL` and `Quote.NON_NUMERIC` policies.
- **`println`:** writes the record separator and resets new-record state (next `print` has no leading delimiter); **null record separator writes nothing** (the CSV-106 / Csv-5 regression point); custom separator.
- **`printRecord` / `printRecords`:** varargs, `Iterable`, no-arg (separator only), null element → empty field, fields needing quotes; array-of-arrays, iterable/array with mixed element types (array + iterable + scalar), empty iterable writes nothing; JDBC `ResultSet` via in-memory H2.
- **`printComment`:** no-op when disabled (and doesn't consume new-record state), single line, multi-line, `\r\n` normalization, starts a fresh line after a value.
- **`close` / `flush`:** delegate to an underlying `Closeable`/`Flushable` (verified via a tracking `Writer`); safe no-ops when the appendable is a plain `StringBuilder`, with output still intact.
- **Predefined formats:** `MYSQL` (tab delimiter, LF separator, `\`-escaping of embedded tab), `TDF` (quotes value containing a tab).
